card.title: RYHMÄ SUSI
card.text: At the start of your turn, lose 1 kredit and draw a card.
card.flavorText: Ryhmä Susi (e. Wolf Group) was a Finnish Army formation during the Winter War, operating under the North Finland Group. Led by Lieutenant Colonel Paavo Susitaival, a veteran of the 27th Jäger Battalion and a member of Parliament, the group was tasked with defending the northern flank of the Suomussalmi front. In December 1939, Ryhmä Susi engaged Soviet forces advancing along the Kuusamo-Suomussalmi road. Their objectives included defeating Soviet troops, securing the Kiannanniemi area, and cutting off enemy retreat routes near Lake Kianta. While they achieved several of these goals, they were unable to completely sever the Soviet withdrawal paths. The group comprised units such as the 6th Cycling Battalion, Separate Battalion 16, and the 1st Battalion of the 65th Infantry Regiment. Employing guerrilla tactics and leveraging their knowledge of the terrain, Ryhmä Susi effectively disrupted Soviet supply lines and communications. Their actions contributed significantly to the Finnish victory at the Battle of Suomussalmi, where outnumbered Finnish forces managed to encircle and defeat larger Soviet units. Following the conclusion of the Winter War in March 1940, Ryhmä Susi was disbanded as part of the broader demobilization of Finnish forces.
